Our proposed terms include commencement and rent conditioned on delivery in the agreed condition, capped controllable operating expenses with audit rights, Landlord responsibility for structural and capital repairs, reasonable assignment and subletting consent with permitted affiliate transfers, appropriate notice and cure periods, and no accelerated rent or obligation to restore alterations unless expressly agreed in advance.

drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Thank you. We agree that the draft remains incomplete and is not ready for execution. We have marked your proposed delivery, expense, and transfer protections for discussion, expressly subject to Landlord’s review and approval. Your repair, cure, remedies, and restoration proposals are also recorded as open items, not accepted terms. Please provide Tenant’s legal particulars, the proposed premises description, rent schedule, commencement date, and specific expense-cap and cure-period proposals after receiving instructions. All terms remain subject to client approval and execution of a complete agreement.

edits.text: 2. RENT. Monthly Base Rent, payment dates, escalations, concessions, and any security deposit remain to be agreed and inserted in a rent schedule. Responsibility for operating expenses, taxes, and utilities also remains to be agreed. [TENANT PROPOSAL—SUBJECT TO LANDLORD APPROVAL: Rent shall commence only upon delivery of the Premises in the agreed delivery condition. Controllable operating expenses shall be subject to an agreed cap, with Tenant audit rights. The cap, exclusions, allocation methodology, audit procedures, and remedies remain to be agreed.]

3. TERM. The lease term is sixty months commencing on the Commencement Date, which remains to be defined. [TENANT PROPOSAL—SUBJECT TO LANDLORD APPROVAL: Commencement shall be conditioned on delivery of the Premises in the agreed delivery condition.] The delivery condition, target delivery date, consequences of delayed delivery, expiration date, and any renewal rights remain to be agreed.

4. ASSIGNMENT AND SUBLETTING. The Tenant shall not assign this Lease or sublet the Premises without the Landlord’s consent. [TENANT PROPOSAL—SUBJECT TO LANDLORD APPROVAL: Consent shall not be unreasonably withheld, conditioned, or delayed, and qualifying affiliate transfers shall be permitted without consent.] The definition of qualifying affiliate transfers, applicable notice and documentation requirements, treatment of changes of control, and continuing liability of the original Tenant remain to be agreed.

Open Tenant proposal, not accepted: Landlord responsibility for structural and capital repairs. Obtain client instructions and define the scope, any exceptions for Tenant-caused damage, and whether related costs may be passed through as operating expenses.

Open Tenant proposals, not accepted: appropriate default notices and cure periods; no accelerated rent; and no obligation to restore alterations unless expressly agreed in advance. Draft complete default, remedies, alterations, and surrender provisions after client instructions. Specify any restoration requirement when approving the relevant alteration.

partner.private_reasoning: The rendered lease and cover note do not disclose the client's confidential severance threshold. No hidden content or other confidential disclosure is identified in the supplied package.

receiver.message_back: Without conceding any open issue and subject to Tenant’s instructions and approval of a complete lease, Tenant proposes a 3% cumulative annual cap on controllable operating expenses, excluding capital and structural costs from pass-throughs, with annual audit rights and reimbursement of overcharges; default remedies should require written notice and five business days to cure monetary defaults and 30 days for nonmonetary defaults, extended while cure is diligently pursued. Please circulate a complete revised draft retaining our delivery, transfer, repair, no-acceleration, and advance-agreed restoration protections as Tenant proposals; Tenant’s legal particulars, premises description, rent schedule, and commencement arrangements will follow once confirmed, and no term is accepted pending execution.
